notes: Carpet Cloud Reconciliation + Desktop Workbench. Adds safe roll-level merge for Carpet Inventory so a roll present on one device (for example 2347) is not blocked by whole-dataset conflicts on another device. Cloud status is now actionable with a conflict inspector and a dedicated Reconcile Carpet Inventory action. Desktop layouts use wide-screen workbench grids instead of stretching the mobile layout, while phone layouts remain compact. No database schema change.
